title: AP Registration Page - Accessibility Test Plan (WCAG 2.1 AA)
overview: Accessibility testing of the Assistive Partner Registration page covering form validation, OTP flow, autocomplete attributes, and form landmark identification.

testCases.title: Form fields have aria-describedby and aria-invalid on errors
testCases.wcagCriterion: 3.3.1 Error Identification (Level A), 4.1.2 Name Role Value (Level A)
testCases.preconditions: User is on AP Registration page
steps: 2. Enter invalid email in Official Email ID field
4. Inspect field for aria-invalid and aria-describedby attributes
expectedResults: Field has aria-invalid='true' when input is invalid
Field has aria-describedby pointing to error message element
Screen reader announces error when field receives focus

testCases.title: OTP dynamic content announced via aria-live
testCases.preconditions: User is on AP Registration page with valid email entered
steps: 1. Enter valid email in Official Email ID field
3. Check for aria-live region in DOM
4. Verify OTP field appearance is announced to screen readers
expectedResults: aria-live='polite' or role='status' region announces OTP sent
OTP input field appearance communicated to assistive technology

testCases.title: Email and phone fields have autocomplete attributes
testCases.componentElement: AP Registration Form - Email and Phone fields
testCases.preconditions: User is on AP Registration page
steps: 1. Inspect Official Email ID input element

testCases.title: Form element has accessible name
testCases.preconditions: User is on AP Registration page
steps: 1. Use screen reader to list form landmarks
2. Check if form has aria-label or aria-labelledby
3. Verify form is announced with descriptive name
expectedResults: Form has aria-label or aria-labelledby attribute
Screen reader announces form purpose (e.g., 'Partner Registration')
